data.title: Rejection of child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) application
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte rejected David Muster's application for the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) filed on 06.10.2025, for the benefit period October 2025 to March 2026. The reason given is that the household's income exceeds the maximum income limit under § 6a BKGG (case number 215KZ508814).
data.explanation: This letter from the German Family Benefits Office (Familienkasse) informs you that your application for the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) was denied because your household income was too high according to their calculation. If you disagree, you have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse by the deadline shown, in writing, electronically, or in person. If you do not object by then, this decision becomes final. Check the enclosed income calculation carefully; if something looks wrong, it may help to get advice from a social advice center (Sozialberatung) or lawyer before the deadline.

key_facts.value: Einkommen übersteigt Höchsteinkommensgrenze nach § 6a Abs. 1 Nr. 3 BKGG

Höchsteinkommensgrenze nach § 6a Abs. 1 Nr. 3 BKGG.
